title: Vanilla Core
description: Lightweight Vanilla modpack focused on performance and visuals!
body:
Vanilla Core is a Fabric modpack for Minecraft focused on performance improvements and visual enhancements while keeping vanilla gameplay unchanged.

## Features

Performance optimization (Sodium, Lithium, Entity Culling), shader support (Iris), and visual/QoL mods like dynamic lighting and zoom.
